commits.message:
Used UrlHelper.Link instead of UrlHelper.Route

I'm not entirely sure why I didn't originally do this, but perhaps
UrlHelper.Link wasn't available in ASP.NET Web API 1. If it was, it must
have been my own ignorance.

Incremented patch version,

in order to indicate that the application of Postel's law, making
Hyprlinkr more tolerant of Web API dependency versions, is a fix rather
than a new feature.
Ignored .vs Visual Studio user directory.
Updated Zero29 NuGet package.
Merge branch 'master' into hmigneron-webapi2-compat
Updated build-release script to work with VS 2015.

Updated icon URL in .nuspec,

since it seems that GitHub changed the URL.
Updated NuGet dependency of Web API to 5.2.3.
Updated NuGet spect to target .NET 4.5.

Incremented patch version,

in order to indicate that a changed NuGet icon isn't a new feature.
Changed to more NuGet-friendly NuGet icon.
Added a CONTRIBUTION.md file.

Incremented patch version,

in order to indicate that addition of GetUri overloads and variations
mostly constitute a fix for a design omission.

Added GetUri overloads to IResourceLinker.

These methods are implemented on RouteLinker, but not defined by
IResourceLinker, making the interface rather useless.

Resolved a build script problem where unit test

assemblies weren't being picked up when the directory had been cleaned.
Added information about versioning to ReadMe.

Incremented minor version,

in order to indicate that the addition of a GetLinkAsync extension method
is a new feature.
Updated build scripts to work with VS 2013.

Made VS Solution compatible with VS 2013.

This enables Visual Studio 2013 to open and compile the solution file in
the IDE itself, whereas the build-release.sh script doesn't yet work on a
clean install of Windows 8.1 with Visual Studio 2013.
Updated AutoFixture NuGet packages.
Updated Zero29 NuGet package.
Updated Moq NuGet package.
Updated Xunit NuGet packages.

Incremented patch version,

in order to indicate that this resolves a bug, but adds no new features.

Handled null arguments when creating URI.

This resolves #26 (https://github.com/ploeh/Hyprlinkr/issues/26).
Renamed test class to match SUT name.

Moved ProjectToBuild property to .config file,

because the location of solution files may vary.
Added paragraph about using extension methods.
Added paragraph on how to use Web API 2.

Incremented major version,

partially because the previous commits have cleaned up the API by deleting
some some types and methods, and partially because now that Web API 2 is
out, it's time to release a proper release version.
Corrected icon URL in .nuspec file.
Changed copyright year in .nuspec to 2014.

Refactored GetMethodInfo

to GetMethodCallExpression, in order to make it useful from three other
call sites.
Also removed the XML documentation comments from the ExpressionExtensions,
since there's no reason to take on the overhead of maintaining XML
comments for non-public APIs.

Inlined GetBodyMethodCallExpression,

since it was only used at a single call site.
Updated copyright year to 2014.

Made GetBodyMethodCallExpression private,

because it wasn't used by any other class in the code base.

Moved GetParameterValue to test project,

because, like other extension methods, this one shouldn't be public,
because it doesn't particularly relate to the main purpose of Hyprlinkr to
extend LINQ expressions. It should not be the responsibility of Hyprlinkr
to support extensions for LINQ expressions.

Additionally, this public method was only used by a test setup method, but
served no purpose related to Hyprlinkr.

Made GetMethodInfo internal,

because, like other extension methods, this one shouldn't be public,
because it doesn't particularly relate to the main purpose of Hyprlinkr to
extend LINQ expressions. It should not be the responsibility of Hyprlinkr
to support extensions for LINQ expressions.

Made GetBodyMethodCallExpression internal,

because, like other extension methods, this one shouldn't be public,
because it doesn't particularly relate to the main purpose of Hyprlinkr to
extend LINQ expressions. It should not be the responsibility of Hyprlinkr
to support extensions for LINQ expressions.

Removed Arg<T>,

because too many libraries already introduce similar classes to model
anonymous data for use in expression, like e.g. Moq's It.IsAny<T>().

The only reason Arg<T> currently exists in the Hyprlinkr is because it's
used in a single unit test. This doesn't seem to justify another type,
which seems to only serve a purpose of syntactic sugar. Clients of
Hyprlinkr kan easily define their own Arg<T>, or reuse an existing
equivalent, like Moq's It.IsAny<T>().

Removed ReflectionExtensions,

because the purpose of Hyprlinkr is to deal with RESTful hyperlinks, not
extending Reflection. There's no reason to publish an API that has no
relation to the main purpose, and Hyprlinkr shouldn't take on that support
responsibility.
Added note about also working with Web API 2.
Fixed a bug in the sample service.
Added icon URL to NuGet spec file.

Added logos supplied by Francesco Gallarotti.

(https://github.com/ploeh/Hyprlinkr/issues/24)

Changed property name to more descriptive name,

although NuGetPackageDependencyRoot also sounds rather cryptic. The idea
is that you may have a root package, which other, glue libraries or
anciliary libraries may depend upon.

Extracted variables to separate config file,

which hypothetically opens up for using a shared BuildRelease file across
multiple projects.

Parameterized NuGet package name,

but since Hyprlinkr has no Glue Libraries that depends on Hyprlinkr, I'm
not completely sure if this actually works...
Moved some build parameters to top of build file.
Extracted NuGet tools path to a build property.

Incremented minor version,

in order to indicate that the addition of an extension method on UrlHelper
is a new feature. This resolves #21
(https://github.com/ploeh/Hyprlinkr/issues/21).
Merge branch '21-add-urlhelper-extensions-redux2' of https://github.com/dlongest/Hyprlinkr into dlongest-21-add-urlhelper-extensions-redux2

Turned all version metadata into four-digit

versions, since that's the format Zero29 currently understands.
Added Zero29 NuGet package.
Ignored NuGetPackages and Release folder.
Added automated build files.

Renamed .nuspec file to have same name as assembly

- both because it's more consistent that way, but also because certain
  steps in the automated build process depends on this convention.

Added NuGet.CommandLine NuGet package,

in order to be able to execute NuGet scripts from the command line.
Moved NuGet specification to own folder.

Added Xunit.Runners NuGet package,

in order to be able to run unit tests from the command line.
Added licence URL to .nuspec file.

Incremented minor version,

in order to indicate that support for async Controllers is a new feature.
Filled out a couple of assembly attributes.

Aligned assembly version for UnitTest45 project

with all other projects.

Added XML comments on GetUriAsync,

as well as suppressed a CA warning.
Added a test for MethodCallExpression.
Added a Guard Clause to GetUriAsync.

Added GetUriAsync method,

in order to support async controllers.

Added XUnit.Extensions NuGet package

to UnitTest45 project.

Added AutoFixture.AutoMoq NuGet package

to UnitTest45 project.

Added Microsoft.AspNet.WebAPI.Core NuGet package

to UnitTest45 project.

Added Newtonsoft.Json NuGet package to UnitTest45

project.

Updated Json.NET to newest version,

because there were inconsistent versions in use across various projects.
Added AutoFixture.Xunit NuGet pkg to UnitTest45.

Added UnitTest45 project,

which will be used for .NET 4.5-specific unit tests (e.g. async support).
When Hyprlinkr itself is upgraded to .NET 4.5, this project should be
merged with the standard unit test project.

Incremented patch version,

in order to indicate a 'bug fix' by throwing a more explicit exception.

Incremented patch version,

in order to indicate a 'bug fix' by throwing a more explicit exception.
Addressed some CA warnings.

Threw a (hopefully) helpful exception

when UrlHelper.Route returns null.
Added OSS licence

Incremented minor version,

indicating that support RouteLinker's support for F# is a new feature.
Added assembly-level attributes to F# test project
Addressed a Code Analysis warning.
Added XML documentation to new GetUri overload.
Refactored towards more DRY code.
Added a Guard Clause for MethodCallExpression.
Added a Null Guard to new GetUri overload.

Added GetUri overload with Func expression,

instead of an Action expression, to support F# usage. The method still
needs defensive coding added.

Added AutoFixture.Xunit NuGet packages

to F# unit test project.

Added a project reference to Hyprlinkr

to the F# test project.

Added an F# library to contain tests written in F#

in order to verify that Hyprlinkr is also usable from F#.
